answer: An attester must stake 31% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a inexpensive one. Because the mirror stake is held until the jade settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the prism audit lists each exposure. A farm running 42 keys hence pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation inexpensive. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
